image_description: A large, white, blimp-style airship floating low over a grassy field with hills in the background. The airship has a bulbous, somewhat rounded envelope rather than a strictly cigar shape. It features a small gondola underneath, but the connection appears structurally ambiguous. There is significant visual distortion on the side of the hull resembling melted gold/yellow streaks and illegible text. The tail fins are visible but lack clear definition.
